pytest_args_reason: Scoped to the population-seam classes, which build small synthetic b9c/b9a/b9d fixtures and need no external artifact. Burned-mode behaviour is covered by PopulationTests and CoordinateSeam; the fresh paths by FreshPopulationSeams. Narrowing is about which guards the score covers -- the four pins' fresh handling -- not about hiding a class that would fail; every declared mutant lives in these paths.
record_is_not_evidence_of_correctness: a killed mutant shows a guard is load-bearing, not that the guard is right
